facts.text: This drink is very good. Where I come from we would have a feast of forty courses, but I will settle for one.
facts.why: A note in Thor's voice, not a quote. The diner scene is real: Jane, Darcy and Erik take him for his first coffee and he smashes the mug and demands 'another!' The forty course feast is invented but does not contradict the film. Keep it without quote marks. The film's own line is only 'Another!', too short to use as a quote.

facts.text: Serve the drinks when Thor smashes his mug in the diner and asks for another.
facts.why: In the diner Thor slams his mug to the ground and loudly demands 'another!' It is his first taste of coffee. The Wikipedia plot summary opened skips the scene, so the confirmation is from an AV Club article.

facts.text: Darcy tased him. He's still hungry.
facts.why: Darcy tasers Thor when he is found. The hunger is a menu joke.
Jane is one of the three who take Thor to the diner. Plain menu joke that claims nothing specific.

vibe.verdict: The diner idea is spot on and the mug smash is the right centrepiece, but the food has little Asgard in it and the note is not a real line.
